'''Hester Bijl''' is a Dutch mathematician and since 15 January 2026 the [[rector magnificus]] of [[Delft University of Technology]]<ref>https://www.tudelft.nl/en/about-tu-delft/organisation/executive-board/profdrir-hester-bijl</ref>. From 2021 until 2026 she was the [[rector magnificus]] of [[Leiden University]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/staffmembers/hester-bijl|title=Hester Bijl|website=Leiden University}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/news/2024/07/hester-bijl-reappointed-as-rector-magnificus|title=Hester Bijl reappointed as Rector Magnificus|date=July 18, 2024|website=Leiden University}}</ref><ref name=":1">https://www.leru.org/news/prof-dr-hester-bijl-new-rector-magnificus-of-university-leiden</ref><ref name=":2">https://www.leru.org/news/hester-bijl-reappointed-as-rector-magnificus-of-universiteit-leiden</ref>

== Life and career ==
Bijl received a PhD from the [[Delft University of Technology]], along with a master's degree from [[Leiden University]].<ref name=":0" />

In 1999, she started working the Delft University of Technology in the aerodynamics department.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.science.org/content/article/mentoring-opposites|title=Mentoring Opposites|website=www.science.org}}</ref> In 2013, she became dean of the faculty of [[aerospace engineering]] at the Delft University of Technology.<ref name=":1" /> In 2021, Bijl was appointed rector magnificus of Leiden University, succeeding [[Carel Stolker]].<ref name=":1" /> In 2024, she was reappointed.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leidschdagblad.nl/regio/leiden/hester-bijl-herbenoemd-tot-rector-magnificus-aan-universiteit-leiden/16296855.html|title=Hester Bijl herbenoemd tot rector magnificus aan Universiteit Leiden|date=July 19, 2024|website=Leidsch Dagblad}}</ref> She is the first female rector of the university.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/news/2020/04/new-rector-magnificus|title=Hester Bijl new Rector Magnificus of Leiden University|date=April 23, 2020|website=Leiden University}}</ref>

Bijl is on the supervisory board of the [[Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research]] and on the board of the [[Leiden Bio Science Park]].<ref name=":0" /> She has been a visiting researcher at the [[Langley Research Center|NASA Langley Research Center]].<ref name=":0" />
